Base current Treble own Algebra Integral 1.2.2 position manager only, 0x48459abc42e5f5490169d26e1c6cc5eeb5905f07. Official current app uses this exact root. Source is a direct contract without proxy dispatch; Sourcify reports metadata-insensitive match (not exact_match) for creation/runtime, with complete applicable source and full ABI retained. No generic Algebra/fork ABI substituted.

mint/increaseLiquidity pay pool obligations from msg.sender through validated Algebra mint callback. Pool identity is deterministically derived from immutable poolDeployer and token/deployer key, not arbitrary executable calldata. Mint issues a position NFT to recipient. increaseLiquidity needs no ownership check and can donate caller funds to another owner's NFT; it does not grant control. No callbacks, permits, NFT transfers/approvals, farming approvals, pool-initialization opaque bytes or multicall are admitted.

Funding amounts use each underlying token's native units; liquidity uses pool liquidity units and tick range. Desired amounts bound spending and token minima/deadline constrain liquidity changes; actual liquidity may differ for fee-on-transfer tokens. Concentrated liquidity may go out of range and lose value relative to holding tokens, and fees, plugin settings, token behavior and MEV affect economics. No fixed swap fee or LP yield is promised.

decreaseLiquidity requires existing NFT owner/approval and positive liquidity, applies minima/deadline, and records principal plus earned fees as tokens owed; it does not immediately pay out. collect requires existing NFT authority, caps each token by amountMax and debt, updates fees, then pays recipient; recipient zero retains assets in the shared manager and is not a complete withdrawal. Core rounding may pay slightly less than accounted and the full expected amount is debited. burn only deletes a completely emptied position after liquidity and owed tokens are zero.

All selected manager methods are payable, but native payment is wrapped only when token is WETH and manager ETH balance covers the obligation. Excess ETH is not automatically refunded; sweep/refund/unwrap helpers and multicall are excluded. Prefer zero native value and pre-funded WETH token balances/allowance, and direct nonzero external recipients for collection; no refund workflow is provided.

Factory roles can change farming center; pre-farmed positions invoke a fixed liquidity-delta follower and failures may propagate.
